imyvm_finance.commands.market.help.intro: §7ImyvmFinance brings real index quotes into the server economy: §fbuy and sell index shares with in-game money at live prices§7 and ride the market swings.
imyvm_finance.commands.market.help.symbo: §7Enter symbols without the colon, e.g. §fCN000001§7 for CN:000001; suggestions complete them for you.
imyvm_finance.commands.market.help.comma: §e/imyvm-market list §7- List all tradable instruments and their status.
§e/imyvm-market quote <symbol> §7- Show the latest quote for an instrument.
§e/imyvm-market buy <symbol> <units> §7- Estimate the buy cost, then confirm to execute.
§e/imyvm-market estimate <symbol> <units> §7- Estimate the buy cost (same as buy).
§e/imyvm-market sell <positionId> <units> §7- Estimate the sale proceeds, then confirm to execute.
§e/imyvm-market positions [page] §7- Show your positions, value and P&L.
§e/imyvm-market rules §7- Show trading rules, fees and limits.
§e/imyvm-market briefing §7- Toggle the market briefing broadcast.
§e/imyvm-market help §7- Show this introduction and command list.
§e/imyvm-market trading <status|enable|disable> [symbol] §7- Check or control trading switches.
§e/imyvm-market source <status|enable|disable> [market] [provider] §7- Check or control quote providers.
§e/imyvm-market market <status|enable|disable> [market] §7- Check or control market open state.
§e/imyvm-market admin <position|settle> <player name or UUID> <symbol> <units> <snapshotId> §f- Inspect or force-settle with a historical snapshot.
